title: LIMENORA Agent Binding
description: Maps a LIMENORA-validated agent service credential to an external agent identity (NOMIVELA agent_ref) and its form (agent_class). Shared contract between the Go and Rust gateways and PRAXOVELA. identity_mode=native means LIMENORA validates its own token; identity_mode=federated means LIMENORA verifies an external assertion (EIDOVELA PoP token).

agent_ref.description: NOMIVELA agent reference (identity authority is NOMIVELA).

agent_class.description: NOMIVELA agentClass (ADR 0005). Selects the gateway/scope profile.

identity_type.description: Agent Identity type (AIOS / AEGIVELA section 3.1). With agent_class it selects the credential context and approval default; refines (never widens) the agent_class profile.

authority.description: Issuer of the credential: 'limenora' for native; 'eidovela' or 'nomivela' for federated.

agent_epoch.description: NOMIVELA business epoch bound at credential issue time (epoch 1 is the first bound value).

identity_epoch.description: NOMIVELA identity epoch bound at credential issue time (epoch 1 is the first bound value).
